desc:
<A:O17> is a popular joseki but requires a favorable ladder for Black from White's cutting stone.

<B:L17> is another popular joseki that also involves a ladder from White's cutting stone.

<C:N15> is also possible.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 12, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Wang Haoyang 6p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TfWuJdOQH28&t=234s).
